lessons.title: Maximum subarray sum
lessons.summary: Decide when to extend a contiguous segment and when to start again.
lessons.idea: At each index, compare extending the previous segment with starting at the current value.
lessons.invariant: After processing an index, ending is the largest sum of any segment ending there. best is the largest sum seen so far.
lessons.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
lessons.prompt: Return the largest sum of any non-empty contiguous segment in nums. nums is non-empty and may contain negative values. Ignore target.
notes: Start with the first value so an all-negative list returns a negative sum.
Compare ending + nums[i] with nums[i] before updating ending.
Track the best sum separately so a later drop does not erase it.

trace.title: Start at index 0
trace.detail: The segment [4] has sum 4. The best sum so far is 4.

trace.title: Extend at index 1
trace.detail: Extending gives −2, compared with −6 if you restart. The best sum so far stays at 4.

trace.title: Restart at index 2
trace.detail: Starting at 3 beats extending to a sum of 1. The best sum so far stays at 4.

trace.title: Extend at index 3
trace.detail: Extending [3] with 5 gives 8. The best segment is [3, 5].

trace.title: Restart at index 1
trace.detail: Starting at −2 beats extending to −7. The best sum so far becomes −2.

trace.title: Restart at index 2
trace.detail: Starting at −4 beats extending to −6. The best sum so far stays at −2.

prediction.prompt: For [2, −5, 4, 1], the best sum ending just before 4 is −3. What should you do when you reach 4?
prediction.explanation: Starting at 4 gives 4. Extending the previous segment gives −3 + 4 = 1.
prediction.hint: Compare the sum of starting at 4 with the sum of adding 4 to −3.
